Title: Rohan's Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Ajay - 40 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Neeta, Ajay and Isha stand near him.]

Rohan: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan puts on his school uniform.]

Rohan: "I knew it!"

[Rohan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Rohan: "Let's see."

[Rohan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Ajay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan reads a storybook.]

Rohan: "I'm ready!"

[Rohan types on his laptop.]

Ajay: "Exactly right."

[Rohan watches cartoons on TV.]

Rohan (happily): "That was fun!"

[Rohan knocks on the door.]

Ajay: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Ajay stand near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan draws a picture of the house.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan trips over a stone.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan bumps his head on the door frame and his forehead bleeds.]

Rohan (gently): "I really enjoyed today."
